Ashe.escape: Ashe has no mobility spell, so the moment Ashe W Volley is down is your chance to engage. If Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow is available, don’t start a small skirmish from out of vision. Before engaging, plan your escape using Pyke E Phantom Undertow or your team’s crowd control.
Ashe.build: Complete a first core item with lethality first. Ashe has low armor, so Pyke’s physical damage is effective. The available information isn’t enough to determine which resistance to build.
Ashe.combo: From a distance, charge Pyke Q Bone Skewer to pull Ashe in, immediately chain Pyke E Phantom Undertow, then use Pyke R Death From Below after a basic attack once she is within execute range. If you’re close, approach with Pyke W Ghostwater Dive, tap Pyke Q Bone Skewer, then land Pyke E Phantom Undertow.
Ashe.fight: Trade after Ashe W Volley is down and Ashe Q Ranger’s Focus has expired. Don’t spend a long time approaching on foot and let Ashe P Frost Shot keep slowing you; close the gap with Pyke E Phantom Undertow and land Pyke Q Bone Skewer.
Ashe.laning: Keep Ashe under pressure within Pyke Q Bone Skewer range by moving between brushes and vision gaps. Go in with your ranged carry after they push the wave, and avoid a reckless opening that could cost you the opportunity by taking heavy damage. Roam when the wave is pushing toward the enemy and your ranged carry can hold the lane alone.
Ashe.phase: In mid game, after completing your first core item with lethality, use roams to impact other lanes. In late game, it becomes harder to bring enemies with more health below the execute threshold and you can be taken down first, so choose your engages carefully.
Ashe.teamfight: After your team’s crowd control draws the enemy’s attention, approach Ashe, who has no mobility spell, from the flank with Pyke W Ghostwater Dive. Leave yourself an escape route when you go in, lower Ashe’s health below the execute threshold, then use Pyke R Death From Below. If you get a reset after the execute, target the lowest-health enemy first.
Ashe.watch: Ashe P Frost Shot’s slow is refreshed with every basic attack, so don’t stay within her attack range for long. Dodge Ashe W Volley by moving sideways, and don’t start a small skirmish from out of vision while Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow is available.

Zyra.phase: In mid game, after completing your first core item with lethality, roam when the wave is pushing toward the enemy and your allied marksman can hold alone. In late game, it’s hard to bring enemies below your execute threshold, so don’t take fights while tanking damage first.
Zyra.build: Get movement speed first so you can leave Zyra’s telegraphed areas. If you build resistance against damage from Zyra P Garden of Thorns, Zyra Q Deadly Spines, and Zyra E Grasping Roots, choose magic resistance.
Zyra.combo: After Zyra E Grasping Roots misses, close in with Pyke W Ghostwater Dive, tap Pyke Q Bone Skewer, and look to stun with Pyke E Phantom Undertow. If you have a clear pull, hold Pyke Q Bone Skewer and follow a hit immediately with Pyke E Phantom Undertow. Use Pyke R Death From Below after an auto attack when you can execute.
Zyra.escape: The moment Zyra E Grasping Roots has been spent is your chance to engage, and Zyra has no ability to create distance on her own. Before going in, decide whether to use Pyke E Phantom Undertow to engage or save it to escape Zyra R Stranglethorns.
Zyra.fight: Dodge Zyra E Grasping Roots sideways, then close the distance when there are no plants nearby. If you need to retreat after taking damage, use Pyke W Ghostwater Dive to break vision and heal with Pyke P Gift of the Drowned Ones.
Zyra.laning: Keep up pressure with Pyke Q Bone Skewer from bushes and vision blind spots, and go in with your allied marksman when they have pushed the wave. If Zyra uses an ability when you approach to step on a seed, back off and approach again. Don’t fight where there are many plants. Before approaching a bush where Zyra has stayed for a while, check for an ambush.
Zyra.teamfight: Avoid fighting where Zyra has stocked seeds and plants; move the fight elsewhere. After your allies apply crowd control, approach from the flank with Pyke W Ghostwater Dive and target the backline, leaving yourself an escape route. Execute the lowest-health enemy with Pyke R Death From Below to keep the resets going.
Zyra.watch: If Zyra E Grasping Roots roots you, it can be followed by plant damage and the knock-up from Zyra R Stranglethorns, so dodge E by moving sideways at the edge of its range. When you see the cast indicator for Zyra R Stranglethorns, walk out of its area and, if needed, escape with Pyke E Phantom Undertow, which you saved.

Milio.build: Prioritize completing a first core item with lethality, then roam during Pyke’s power spike. There’s no reason to build armor just for Milio’s damage, but choose resistances based on the enemy carry’s damage type. If the healing from Milio W Cozy Campfire and Milio R Breath of Life is a problem, bring forward your anti-heal item.
Milio.combo: If Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick is down, hold Pyke Q Bone Skewer to pull a target, then immediately follow with Pyke E Phantom Undertow to layer the stun. Follow with autos to lower health, and finish with Pyke R Death From Below once health falls below the execute threshold. If you’ve approached close with Pyke W Ghostwater Dive, tap Pyke Q Bone Skewer, then follow with Pyke E Phantom Undertow.
Milio.escape: Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick is his only disengage tool, knocking back the first enemy he hits, so engage after it’s down. Milio has no mobility, so that’s your chance to close the gap with Pyke E Phantom Undertow or Pyke R Death From Below and hit Pyke Q Bone Skewer.
Milio.fight: If Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick is down, use Pyke W Ghostwater Dive to change your angle and approach. If you’re close, tap Pyke Q Bone Skewer for a quick hit and aim to stun with Pyke E Phantom Undertow. After taking damage, break vision with Pyke W Ghostwater Dive or a bush to benefit from Pyke P Gift of the Drowned Ones’ healing.
Milio.laning: Pressure from bushes and vision blind spots while watching for Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick, and go in together after your allied marksman pushes the wave. If you’ve forced the enemy back with Pyke W Ghostwater Dive, establish river vision and roam only when your allied marksman can hold the wave alone.
Milio.phase: Milio’s team gets stronger as the game goes on, and it becomes harder for Pyke to lower enemies’ health to the execute threshold, so avoid forcing an engage first in the late game.
Milio.teamfight: After Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick is down and allied crowd control draws the enemy’s attention, approach from the flank with Pyke W Ghostwater Dive and target Milio, who has low defensive stats and no mobility. Before going in, decide whether to create an exit with Pyke E Phantom Undertow. When an enemy is within execute range, finish the lowest-health target first with Pyke R Death From Below to keep the resets going.
Milio.watch: Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick knocks back the first enemy hit, so don’t rush in while it’s available. While Milio W Cozy Campfire extends the enemy marksman’s range, don’t fight up front; let its duration run out. Milio R Breath of Life grants healing and tenacity, so don’t leave Milio free to act in teamfights.

Lulu.fight: Lulu is strong at stopping hard engages, so don’t force an early engage; keep pressuring and poking from bushes and vision blind spots. When Lulu W Whimsy is down or Lulu E Help, Pix! has been used to shield an ally, use Pyke W Ghostwater Dive to find an angle on Lulu herself.
Lulu.build: Complete your first core item with lethality first to reach your power spike sooner. Magic resistance helps if you need to withstand Lulu’s damage, but choose resistance based on the damage type of the target she’s protecting, and consider tenacity against Lulu W Whimsy and Lulu R Wild Growth.
Lulu.combo: If you’ve closed in from out of vision with Pyke W Ghostwater Dive, tap Pyke Q Bone Skewer for a quick hit and follow with Pyke E Phantom Undertow to stun. If you have an angle to pull, hold Pyke Q Bone Skewer, then immediately use Pyke E Phantom Undertow on hit and lower the target’s health with an auto before finishing with Pyke R Death From Below once the target is within execute range.
Lulu.escape: Lulu has no dash to get herself out, so the opportunity to close the gap comes after Lulu W Whimsy is used on another ally. When you go in with Pyke E Phantom Undertow, keep Lulu on the line the ghost returns along, and decide on an exit before engaging.
Lulu.laning: Stand behind minions to reduce the extra damage from Lulu P Pix, Faerie Companion. If you take a heavy hit, break vision with Pyke W Ghostwater Dive or a bush to heal with Pyke P Gift of the Drowned Ones. Look for an angle to go in together after your allied marksman pushes the wave, and roam only when they can hold the wave alone.
Lulu.phase: Mid game, after completing your first core item with lethality, is your peak, so extend your advantage through roams. In the late game, it’s hard to lower health to execute range and Pyke is easy to burst first, so avoid engaging first.
Lulu.teamfight: After allied crowd control draws the enemy’s attention, flank with Pyke W Ghostwater Dive and target Lulu herself or another enemy instead of a target Lulu can save with Lulu R Wild Growth. Execute the lowest-health enemy first with Pyke R Death From Below to chain resets, and leave yourself an exit when you go in.
Lulu.watch: Lulu R Wild Growth increases its target’s health and knocks up nearby enemies, so don’t count a target with R available as a guaranteed execute.

Alistar.teamfight: Don’t spend your damage on Alistar while Alistar R Unbreakable Will is active; target a dangerous backline damage dealer instead. After your team’s crowd control lands, approach from the flank with Pyke W Ghostwater Dive and finish the lowest-health enemy with Pyke R Death From Below to look for a reset. If you need to interrupt an engage even after Alistar activates his ultimate, apply fresh crowd control with Pyke Q Bone Skewer or Pyke E Phantom Undertow.
Alistar.build: Prioritize a first core item with lethality. Alistar’s high armor makes physical damage less effective, and lethality also raises Pyke R Death From Below’s execute threshold. If you build resistance against Alistar’s damage, choose magic resistance over armor.
Alistar.combo: When Alistar W Headbutt is down, charge Pyke Q Bone Skewer to pull him in, then immediately chain Pyke E Phantom Undertow to stun him. Follow with basic attacks to lower his health, then finish with Pyke R Death From Below once he is below the execute threshold. To engage from close range, use Pyke W Ghostwater Dive to approach, tap Pyke Q Bone Skewer, then cast Pyke E Phantom Undertow.
Alistar.escape: Right after you force Alistar to use his mobility spell, Alistar W Headbutt, is your chance to engage. If Alistar Q Pulverize is also down, close the distance with Pyke E Phantom Undertow and catch him with Pyke Q Bone Skewer. Pyke E Phantom Undertow is also needed for your escape, so choose your way out before going in.
Alistar.fight: Look for an opening right after Alistar Q Pulverize and Alistar W Headbutt are down. If you’re close, tap Pyke Q Bone Skewer for a quick stab, then chain the stun with Pyke E Phantom Undertow. If you take damage, break vision with Pyke W Ghostwater Dive or a brush, heal with Pyke P Gift of the Drowned Ones, then fight again.
Alistar.laning: Pressure Alistar from Pyke Q Bone Skewer range by moving between brushes and vision gaps, and look for an angle to go in with your ranged carry after they push the wave. When Alistar Q Pulverize and Alistar W Headbutt are down, push the lane or reposition during that window. Roam only when the wave is pushing toward the enemy and your ranged carry can hold the lane alone.
Alistar.phase: Your peak is in mid game, after completing your first core item with lethality, so use roams to impact other lanes. In late game, it becomes harder to bring enemies below the execute threshold and you can be taken down first, so avoid forcing an early engage.
Alistar.watch: Keep your distance after Alistar W Headbutt knocks you back so you don’t get caught by the knock-up from Alistar Q Pulverize and the stun from Alistar E Trample. Near a turret, especially, don’t give Alistar room to circle behind you and knock you under it. When Alistar R Unbreakable Will is active, his damage taken is greatly reduced, so back off and wait out its duration.

Heimerdinger.combo: If you’ve approached from the flank with Pyke W Ghostwater Dive, tap Pyke Q Bone Skewer for a quick stab and immediately follow with Pyke E Phantom Undertow to look for a stun. If you have room to pull him in, charge Pyke Q Bone Skewer, then follow with Pyke E Phantom Undertow as soon as it hits so the stun lands when the enemy starts moving again. Lower his health with basic attacks, then finish with Pyke R Death From Below once he is below the execute threshold.
Heimerdinger.build: Work toward a first core item with lethality. Heimerdinger’s major spells all deal magic damage, so choose magic resistance if you build resistance. Also consider movement speed to help you get out of turret and spell range.
Heimerdinger.escape: Heimerdinger has no spell to create distance, so go around his turret setup, close the gap with Pyke E Phantom Undertow, and land Pyke Q Bone Skewer. Before going in, also plan an escape route using Pyke E Phantom Undertow or your team’s crowd control.
Heimerdinger.fight: If you take damage, break vision and heal with Pyke P Gift of the Drowned Ones, then look for another opening.
Heimerdinger.laning: Don’t force yourself to farm the wave within turret range; keep up pressure with Pyke Q Bone Skewer from brushes and vision gaps. If there’s no opening to catch him, apply pressure with Pyke W Ghostwater Dive and secure river vision. Roam when your ranged carry can hold the lane alone.
Heimerdinger.phase: In mid game, after completing your first core item with lethality, use roams to pressure other lanes. In late game, it becomes hard to bring enemies below the execute threshold and you can easily be burst down first, so avoid engaging first.
Heimerdinger.teamfight: If Heimerdinger R UPGRADE!!! is ready, don’t group up in a narrow passage or at one point in front of an objective. After your team’s crowd control lands, approach the side of his turret setup with Pyke W Ghostwater Dive and target a dangerous backliner, leaving yourself an escape route as you go in. Execute the lowest-health enemy with Pyke R Death From Below and keep using its resets.

Bard.laning: Keep up the pressure with Pyke Q Bone Skewer from brushes and vision gaps, and go in with your ranged carry after they push the wave. Step on Bard W Caretaker’s Shrine placed in lane to destroy it.
Bard.watch: Bard Q Cosmic Binding stuns when it hits a wall or a second target, so don’t stand with your back to a wall or in a line with an ally or minion. A target affected by Bard R Tempered Fate takes no damage, so use Pyke R Death From Below after the effect ends. Watch the flanks too, since Bard E Magical Journey can bring him in from the side.
Bard.build: Prioritize a first core item with lethality to raise Pyke’s execute threshold. The damage from Bard P Traveler’s Call and Bard Q Cosmic Binding is magic, so choose magic resistance over armor to defend against Bard’s damage. Positioning to avoid being caught and focused by Bard Q Cosmic Binding’s stun is also important.
Bard.combo: If Bard E Magical Journey is down, charge Pyke Q Bone Skewer to pull him in, then immediately chain Pyke E Phantom Undertow to layer the stun. Lower his health with basic attacks, then finish with Pyke R Death From Below once he reaches the execute threshold. If you’re already close, tap Pyke Q Bone Skewer for a quick stab, then chain Pyke E Phantom Undertow.
Bard.escape: The moment Bard E Magical Journey is down is your window to engage. If Bard Q Cosmic Binding is also down, there’s less risk of being stunned, so close in with Pyke E Phantom Undertow and land Pyke Q Bone Skewer. Before going in, make sure you have a way out with Pyke E Phantom Undertow.
Bard.fight: Bait out Bard E Magical Journey, then close the gap with Pyke E Phantom Undertow and catch him with Pyke Q Bone Skewer. If you take damage in a trade, break vision with Pyke W Ghostwater Dive or a brush, heal with Pyke P Gift of the Drowned Ones, then look for another opening.
Bard.phase: In late game, it becomes harder for Pyke to bring enemies with more health below the execute threshold, and you can be taken down first, so choose your engages carefully.
Bard.teamfight: After your team’s crowd control draws the enemy’s attention, flank with Pyke W Ghostwater Dive and target a dangerous backliner. Don’t rush Pyke R Death From Below against a target made immune to damage by Bard R Tempered Fate. Land Pyke R Death From Below on executable targets first to keep chaining recasts, and leave yourself an escape route when going in.

Pantheon.build: Pyke prioritizes a first core item with physical penetration to deal with Pantheon’s high armor. Build armor first to resist the damage from Pantheon’s main abilities. Since Pantheon W Shield Vault deals damage based on maximum health, be wary of choices that only add a large amount of health.
Pantheon.combo: Watch for Pantheon W Shield Vault, and when you have an angle to pull a target, hold Pyke Q Bone Skewer and immediately follow a hit with Pyke E Phantom Undertow to layer the stun. Follow with basic attacks to lower health, then finish with Pyke R Death From Below when health falls below its execute threshold. If you have a close-range angle, you can approach with Pyke W Ghostwater Dive, tap Pyke Q Bone Skewer, then use Pyke E Phantom Undertow.
Pantheon.escape: Look for an engage after Pantheon W Shield Vault is down, but also check whether Pantheon R Grand Starfall is available. In particular, before Pantheon R Grand Starfall comes back up, close the gap with Pyke E Phantom Undertow or Pyke R Death From Below and catch him with Pyke Q Bone Skewer. Before going in, decide whether to use Pyke E Phantom Undertow to escape or rely on allied crowd control to get out.
Pantheon.fight: Don't initiate a trade while giving Pantheon an opportunity to hit you with W Shield Vault by being within its range. If you take damage, break vision with Pyke W Ghostwater Dive or a brush, heal with Pyke P Gift of the Drowned Ones, then look for an opening again. Once Pantheon E Aegis Assault ends or you have an angle from the side, follow up with Pyke Q Bone Skewer and Pyke E Phantom Undertow.
Pantheon.laning: Early on, avoid trading directly with Pantheon; keep minions between you and him to reduce poke from Pantheon Q Comet Spear. Keep up pressure with Pyke Q Bone Skewer from brushes and vision gaps, and go in with your allied ADC after they push the wave. Roam when the wave is pushing toward the enemy and your allied ADC can hold alone.
Pantheon.phase: At this point, influence other lanes by roaming. In the late game, even though Pantheon's influence falls off, Pyke also has trouble finding execute openings, so avoid engages where you take damage first and get taken down.
Pantheon.teamfight: After your allies land crowd control, use Pyke W Ghostwater Dive to approach from the side and target a dangerous backliner instead of fighting the frontline. Don't attack Pantheon E Aegis Assault from the front; wait for it to end or find an angle from the side. Execute low-health enemies first with Pyke R Death From Below to chain resets, and leave yourself an escape route when you go in.
Pantheon.watch: Pantheon W Shield Vault targets and stuns an enemy, so be careful not to enter its range. Pantheon E Aegis Assault blocks damage from the direction he faces, so wait for it to end before using abilities from the front, or angle in from the side. When you see the landing warning for Pantheon R Grand Starfall, walk out of its landing area.

Blitzcrank.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab and Blitzcrank R Static Field. For your offensive first core, aim for an item with lethality; bonus maximum health also converts into attack damage for Pyke. Since Blitzcrank R Static Field destroys shields, relying on a shield to survive is less effective.
Blitzcrank.combo: If Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab is down, charge Pyke Q Bone Skewer to pull a target in, immediately chain Pyke E Phantom Undertow, then finish with Pyke R Death From Below after basic attacks once the target is at execute health. If you’re already close, approach with Pyke W Ghostwater Dive, tap Pyke Q Bone Skewer, then chain Pyke E Phantom Undertow.
Blitzcrank.escape: The moment Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab misses is your chance to go in. Blitzcrank has no spell to create distance on his own, so close the gap then with Pyke E Phantom Undertow or Pyke R Death From Below and catch him with Pyke Q Bone Skewer. Before you engage, decide whether you’ll use Pyke E Phantom Undertow to create an escape route.
Blitzcrank.fight: Trade right after Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab misses or when he is low on mana. When going in with Pyke E Phantom Undertow, keep the enemy in the path of the returning phantom. If you take damage, break vision with Pyke W Ghostwater Dive or a brush and heal with Pyke P Gift of the Drowned Ones.
Blitzcrank.laning: Keep minions between you and Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab, and use a Control Ward to clear brushes so you don’t give up vision. Threaten an engage with Pyke W Ghostwater Dive without recklessly taking the first hit, and look for an angle to go in with your ranged carry after they push the wave. Roam when the wave is pushing toward the enemy and your ranged carry can hold the lane alone.
Blitzcrank.phase: In late game, Pyke can easily be burst down first and it’s hard to lower enemies’ health to the execute threshold, so choose your engages carefully.
Blitzcrank.teamfight: Instead of focusing on Blitzcrank, wait for your team’s crowd control to draw the enemy’s attention, then flank and target a dangerous backliner with Pyke W Ghostwater Dive. Secure an escape route before going in, then execute the lowest-health enemy with Pyke R Death From Below and keep using its resets.
Blitzcrank.watch: If Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab pulls you in, it can be followed by the knock-up from Blitzcrank E Power Fist and the silence from Blitzcrank R Static Field, so dodge it from behind minions. If you can’t see into a brush, it’s hard to judge grab range, so stay away from brushes.

Brand.build: Complete your first core item with lethality to bring forward Pyke’s strong timing. Build magic resistance over armor against Brand’s damage, and consider movement speed to help you get out of telegraphed areas.
Brand.combo: After Brand W Pillar of Flame is down, charge Pyke Q Bone Skewer to pull a target in, then immediately chain Pyke E Phantom Undertow on hit to layer the stun. Lower the target’s health further with basic attacks, then finish with Pyke R Death From Below once the target is below the execute threshold.
Brand.escape: Brand has no mobility spell, so the moment Brand W Pillar of Flame is down is your chance to close the gap. Brand Q Sear only stuns targets who are burning, so if you’re on fire, avoid it first, then engage with Pyke E Phantom Undertow.
Brand.fight: Look for an opening after Brand W Pillar of Flame is down and Brand himself is not affected by Blaze. If you take damage while trading at close range, break vision with Pyke W Ghostwater Dive and heal with Pyke P Gift of the Drowned Ones.
Brand.laning: Stand to the side, away from burning minions, and pressure Brand from Pyke Q Bone Skewer range using brushes and vision gaps. Go in with your ranged carry after they push the wave, and roam when your ranged carry can hold the lane alone.
Brand.teamfight: After your team’s crowd control lands, approach Brand’s backline position from the flank with Pyke W Ghostwater Dive, and choose your escape route before going in. Keep your distance from allies to avoid Brand E Conflagration spreading and Brand R Pyroclasm bouncing. Target an executable enemy first with Pyke R Death From Below.
Brand.watch: Brand P Blaze stacks when you’re hit by spells in quick succession, then explodes, so dodge the initial hits from Brand Q Sear and Brand W Pillar of Flame. If you’re burning, move out of the projectile’s path or hide behind minions to avoid the stun from Brand Q Sear.

Braum.build: Prioritize completing a first core item with lethality to raise Pyke R Death From Below’s execute threshold. Build magic resistance first against Braum’s main damage. Bonus maximum health converts into attack damage for Pyke, so you can also consider health items.
Braum.combo: When Braum E Unbreakable’s shield is lowered or you can land Pyke Q Bone Skewer from the flank, charge it to pull a target in, then immediately chain Pyke E Phantom Undertow → basic attack → Pyke R Death From Below. If you’re already close, approach with Pyke W Ghostwater Dive, tap Pyke Q Bone Skewer, then cast Pyke E Phantom Undertow. Use Pyke R Death From Below after the target falls below the execute threshold whenever possible.
Braum.escape: Right after you make Braum use Braum W Stand Behind Me is your chance to close the gap. Dodge Braum R Glacial Fissure to the side, then after Braum E Unbreakable’s shield is lowered, engage with Pyke E Phantom Undertow and land Pyke Q Bone Skewer.
Braum.fight: Engage when Braum W Stand Behind Me is down and Braum E Unbreakable’s shield is lowered. Right after pulling a target with Pyke Q Bone Skewer, chain Pyke E Phantom Undertow to layer the stun, and plan your escape route before going in. If you take damage, break vision with Pyke W Ghostwater Dive or a brush, heal with Pyke P Gift of the Drowned Ones, then look for another opening.
Braum.laning: Braum Q Winter’s Bite only hits the first enemy it connects with, so stand behind minions and avoid open straight lines between them. Keep up pressure with Pyke Q Bone Skewer from brushes and vision gaps, then go in with your ranged carry after they push the wave. Use Pyke W Ghostwater Dive to apply pressure or roam when the wave is pushing toward the enemy and your ally can hold the lane alone.
Braum.phase: In mid game, after completing your first core item with lethality, look for roams targeting someone other than the one Braum is protecting. In late game, it becomes harder to bring enemies below the execute threshold, so avoid forcing an early engage.
Braum.teamfight: Target a dangerous backliner Braum is protecting rather than spending your damage on Braum. When your team’s crowd control draws the enemy’s attention, flank with Pyke W Ghostwater Dive and engage from an angle Braum E Unbreakable isn’t facing. Leave yourself an escape route, then finish enemies starting with the lowest-health enemy using Pyke R Death From Below and keep using its resets.
Braum.watch: If you’re hit by Braum Q Winter’s Bite or a basic attack and get a Braum P Concussive Blows stack, use Pyke E Phantom Undertow to get out of range before more stun stacks build up. Don’t throw Pyke Q Bone Skewer into the direction Braum E Unbreakable is facing; wait for the shield to drop or for a flank angle. When you see Braum R Glacial Fissure’s cast, move sideways out of its path and avoid the lingering slow zone.

Hwei.build: Prioritize completing a first core item with lethality to take advantage of Hwei’s low armor. Build magic resistance over armor against Hwei’s magic damage, and don’t stack only health given the max-health damage from Hwei Q Subject: Disaster. Also build movement speed to help you get out of telegraphed areas.
Hwei.combo: If Hwei E Subject: Torment is down, charge Pyke Q Bone Skewer to pull a target in, then immediately chain Pyke E Phantom Undertow on hit to layer the stun. Lower the target’s health with basic attacks, then finish with Pyke R Death From Below once the target is below the execute threshold. If you’ve gotten close with Pyke W Ghostwater Dive, tap Pyke Q Bone Skewer for a quick stab, then chain Pyke E Phantom Undertow.
Hwei.escape: Hwei has no mobility spell, so the moment Hwei E Subject: Torment is down is your chance to engage. Close the gap then with Pyke E Phantom Undertow or Pyke R Death From Below and catch him with Pyke Q Bone Skewer. If Hwei E Subject: Torment is still available, wait, since you could be rooted or pushed back at the front of the engage.
Hwei.fight: Close the gap right after Hwei E Subject: Torment is used for poke or wave clear. If you take damage in a trade, break vision with Pyke W Ghostwater Dive, heal with Pyke P Gift of the Drowned Ones, then look for another opening. Before going in, decide whether you’ll save Pyke E Phantom Undertow for your escape.
Hwei.laning: Check whether Hwei E Subject: Torment’s eye has been placed, and take another route if it has. Fight when your ranged carry has pushed the wave and can go in with you; roam only when the wave lets them hold the lane alone.
Hwei.phase: In mid game, use roams to carry the strength you gain after completing your first core item with lethality to other lanes. In late game, it becomes harder to bring enemies with more health below the execute threshold and you can easily be burst down first, so don’t rush your engage.
Hwei.teamfight: After Hwei E Subject: Torment is down or your team’s crowd control lands first, approach the backline from the flank with Pyke W Ghostwater Dive. Hwei has no mobility spell, so look for a stun with Pyke E Phantom Undertow, then use Pyke R Death From Below once health is below the execute threshold. Leave yourself an escape route when you go in, and after an execute, use the reset opportunity to target another low-health enemy.
Hwei.watch: Hwei E Subject: Torment can stop Pyke’s engage with a root or forced movement and make it easier to land follow-up damage. Don’t enter along a path where an eye has been placed; take another route. If you’re hit by the first spell, reposition immediately to avoid the second spell and Hwei P Signature of the Visionary’s explosion.

Janna.build: Prioritize a first core item with lethality to raise Pyke R Death From Below’s execute threshold. If you need resistance against Janna’s damage, choose magic resistance over armor. Janna’s damage is low, so don’t buy resistance early just because of her.
Janna.combo: If Janna Q Howling Gale is down and Janna E Eye Of The Storm’s shield is gone, hold Pyke Q Bone Skewer to pull a target, then immediately follow with Pyke E Phantom Undertow, an auto, and Pyke R Death From Below to finish. If you’ve closed in with Pyke W Ghostwater Dive, tap Pyke Q Bone Skewer for a quick hit, then follow with Pyke E Phantom Undertow. Use Pyke R Death From Below to finish targets within execute range.
Janna.escape: The window to engage opens when Janna Q Howling Gale’s knock-up and Janna R Monsoon’s knockback are down. Janna can pass through minions thanks to Janna W Zephyr, so don’t try to block her path; close the gap with Pyke E Phantom Undertow and position Janna along the stun line. Before going in, decide whether you’ll use Pyke E Phantom Undertow or allied crowd control to get out.
Janna.fight: After Janna Q Howling Gale and Janna R Monsoon are down, use Pyke W Ghostwater Dive to change your angle and approach. If you’ve drawn out Janna E Eye Of The Storm, deal your damage once the shield is gone. After a short trade, when disengaging, use Pyke W Ghostwater Dive or move out of vision to benefit from Pyke P Gift of the Drowned Ones’ healing.
Janna.laning: Keep up the pressure with Pyke Q Bone Skewer from bushes and vision blind spots, but don’t engage first at the cost of taking heavy damage. Pressure the ally Janna is protecting to make her use Janna E Eye Of The Storm, and look for an opening after making her waste Janna Q Howling Gale or Janna W Zephyr as well. Look for a fight when your allied marksman has pushed the wave and can go in with you.
Janna.phase: In the late game, Pyke is easy to burst first, and it’s hard to lower enemies’ health to execute range, so don’t engage first from the front.
Janna.teamfight: If Janna stays behind an allied damage dealer, the engage gets pushed back, so establish vision and look for a moment when she’s isolated. After allied crowd control lands, approach from the flank with Pyke W Ghostwater Dive, and save Pyke E Phantom Undertow’s stun to interrupt Janna R Monsoon. Execute the lowest-health enemy first with Pyke R Death From Below to keep the resets going.
Janna.watch: Janna Q Howling Gale interrupts engages with its knock-up, so avoid its path if you hear the tornado from out of vision. Janna R Monsoon knocks away an approaching Pyke, so keep in mind that your engage may be thwarted while it is available. Don’t dump all your damage at once into a target protected by Janna E Eye Of The Storm.

Karma.build: Build magic resistance early against Karma’s primary damage. Then complete a first core item with lethality to raise Pyke R Death From Below’s execute threshold and gain the strength to roam.
Karma.combo: If Karma W Focused Resolve is down and Karma E Inspire’s shield has ended, hold Pyke Q Bone Skewer to pull a target, then immediately follow with Pyke E Phantom Undertow and an auto. Once the target’s health falls below the execute threshold, finish with Pyke R Death From Below. If you’ve closed to melee range, tap Pyke Q Bone Skewer for a quick stab, then follow with Pyke E Phantom Undertow.
Karma.escape: The window to engage with Pyke E Phantom Undertow opens after Karma W Focused Resolve is down. Before going in, decide whether to create an exit with Pyke E Phantom Undertow or rely on allied crowd control to get out. If Karma W Focused Resolve has already connected, create distance to break the tether before you’re rooted.
Karma.fight: Delay your engage right after Karma E Inspire shields a target. When the shield ends and Karma W Focused Resolve is down, use Pyke W Ghostwater Dive to approach from the flank, then chain Pyke Q Bone Skewer into Pyke E Phantom Undertow. If you take damage during the trade, break vision to heal with Pyke P Gift of the Drowned Ones.
Karma.laning: Move between bushes and vision blind spots to pressure Karma with Pyke Q Bone Skewer’s range, but don’t take free hits from Karma Q Inner Flame. Look for an angle to go in together when your allied marksman has pushed the wave. Roam when the wave is pushing toward the enemy and your allied marksman can hold alone.
Karma.phase: In the late game, it’s harder to get enemies below the execute threshold, and Pyke is easy to take down first, so be careful about engaging first.
Karma.teamfight: Delay your engage while Karma W Focused Resolve is available or while the shield from Karma R Mantra-empowered E is on nearby allies. After allied crowd control lands, approach the backline from the flank with Pyke W Ghostwater Dive and target the lowest-health enemy first with Pyke R Death From Below. Leave yourself an exit when you go in.
Karma.watch: Karma Q Inner Flame’s slow and area damage are dangerous, so avoid it by standing behind minions or outside its range. If you’re hit by the flame zone from Karma R Mantra-empowered Q, walk out of the circle before it explodes. If Karma W Focused Resolve connects to you, create distance to break the tether before you’re rooted.

Leona.build: Pyke’s physical damage is blunted by Leona’s high armor, so prioritize a first core item with lethality. Magic resistance is effective against Leona’s own damage, but choose resistance stats based on the damage type of the enemy carry attacking while Leona holds you.
Leona.combo: After Leona E Zenith Blade is down, hold Pyke Q Bone Skewer to pull a target. Immediately follow the hit with Pyke E Phantom Undertow to layer the stun and auto, then finish with Pyke R Death From Below if the target is below the execute threshold.
Leona.escape: Leona E Zenith Blade is her only mobility tool, so the moment after you bait it out is your window to go in. Don’t force an opening hit before Leona’s engage ability is down. When entering with Pyke E Phantom Undertow, keep Leona on the line the ghost will return along, and plan an escape route in advance.
Leona.fight: When Leona W Eclipse is active, move out of its range before it explodes so its defensive stats don’t last longer. After Leona engages with Leona E Zenith Blade, close the gap with Pyke E Phantom Undertow or Pyke R Death From Below and catch her with Pyke Q Bone Skewer. Before going in, decide whether to create an exit with Pyke E Phantom Undertow.
Leona.laning: Leona has high armor early, so maintain pressure with Pyke Q Bone Skewer from bushes and vision blind spots instead of starting a physical damage trade with her. Don’t stand in line with your allied marksman, and look for an angle to go in together after your ally has pushed the wave. Roam when the wave is pushing toward the enemy and your allied marksman can hold alone.
Leona.phase: In the late game, it’s hard to get higher-health enemies below the execute threshold, and Pyke is easy to take down first, so choose your engages carefully.
Leona.teamfight: If Leona P Sunlight marks you, that signals the enemy’s follow-up damage is coming, so don’t move forward; back off. After allied crowd control lands, approach from the flank with Pyke W Ghostwater Dive and target a dangerous enemy in the backline. Execute the lowest-health enemy with Pyke R Death From Below to keep the resets going, but leave yourself an exit when you go in.
Leona.watch: Leona E Zenith Blade pierces in a straight line and attaches Leona to the last champion hit, so don’t stand in a line with your allied marksman. Leona can activate Leona Q Shield of Daybreak before approaching, so watch the distance she can cover rather than whether she’s used the ability. If Leona R Solar Flare’s indicator appears, move to the side to avoid the stun at its center.

Lux.build: Complete your first core item with lethality first to exploit Lux’s low armor. Against Lux’s damage, build magic resistance over armor. Movement speed to get out of Lux E Lucent Singularity also matters.
Lux.combo: If Lux Q Light Binding misses, approach from the flank with Pyke W Ghostwater Dive, tap Pyke Q Bone Skewer, then follow with Pyke E Phantom Undertow. If you have an angle to pull, hold Pyke Q Bone Skewer and immediately use Pyke E Phantom Undertow on hit, then auto. When Lux’s health falls below the execute threshold, finish with Pyke R Death From Below.
Lux.escape: The moment Lux Q Light Binding misses is your chance to engage. Lux has no mobility, so close the gap with Pyke E Phantom Undertow and catch her with Pyke Q Bone Skewer. Before going in, decide whether to create an exit with Pyke E Phantom Undertow or use allied crowd control.
Lux.fight: Bait out Lux Q Light Binding and start the fight right after dodging it. If you’re close, tap Pyke Q Bone Skewer for a quick stab and follow with Pyke E Phantom Undertow. If you’ve taken damage and backed off, break vision with Pyke W Ghostwater Dive or a bush to heal with Pyke P Gift of the Drowned Ones, then look for another angle.
Lux.laning: Don’t stand in line with your allies to avoid getting caught together by Lux Q Light Binding. Keep up the pressure with Pyke Q Bone Skewer from bushes and vision blind spots, and go in together when your allied marksman has pushed the wave. If you’ve forced Lux back with Pyke W Ghostwater Dive, establish river vision and roam when your allied marksman can hold alone.
Lux.phase: In mid game, after completing your first core item with lethality, exploit Lux’s low armor and roam. In the late game, it’s hard to execute higher-health enemies, and Pyke is easy to burst first, so be careful about engaging first.
Lux.teamfight: Approach from different directions so you don’t get caught together in Lux E Lucent Singularity. After allied crowd control lands, flank with Pyke W Ghostwater Dive and target the backline, such as Lux. Finish execute-ready enemies first with Pyke R Death From Below, and leave yourself an exit when you go in.
Lux.watch: If Lux Q Light Binding catches you, you’re likely to get hit by follow-up abilities, so bait it out and dodge first. Leave the area covered by Lux E Lucent Singularity, and move to the side when you see Lux R Final Spark’s red targeting line. If you’re hit by Lux’s abilities, create distance so she can’t pop Lux P Illumination with an auto.

Maokai.build: Prioritize a first core item with lethality. Magic resistance is effective against the damage from Maokai Q Bramble Smash, W Twisted Advance, and E Sapling Toss, but choose resistance based on the enemy carry attacking while Maokai holds you. Also consider tenacity against the roots from Maokai W Twisted Advance and R Nature’s Grasp.
Maokai.combo: When Maokai W Twisted Advance is down, close the gap with Pyke E Phantom Undertow and land Pyke Q Bone Skewer. If you have an angle to pull with a held Q, immediately follow the hit with E to layer the stun, then use an auto and finish with R Death From Below once health falls below the execute threshold. At melee range, approach with W Ghostwater Dive, tap Q, then follow with E.
Maokai.escape: The window to engage opens right after you avoid Maokai W Twisted Advance. Approach with Pyke E Phantom Undertow, but before going in, decide whether to create an exit with E or rely on allied crowd control. Avoid engaging in narrow passages where Maokai R Nature’s Grasp is approaching.
Maokai.fight: Close the gap and trade right after you bait out Maokai W Twisted Advance. Target the enemy carry rather than repeatedly hitting Maokai with abilities and giving him chances to heal.
Maokai.laning: Avoid bushes that may have saplings planted, keep up Q pressure from vision blind spots, and go in together after your allied marksman has pushed the wave. Roam when the wave is pushing toward the enemy and your marksman can hold alone.
Maokai.phase: In mid game, after completing your first core item with lethality, use the opening while Maokai W Twisted Advance is down and affect other lanes with roams. In the late game, it’s hard to get higher-health enemies below the execute threshold, so don’t take hits first in a fight.
Maokai.teamfight: Dodge Maokai R Nature’s Grasp sideways in open terrain, then approach from the flank with Pyke W Ghostwater Dive after allied crowd control lands. Target a dangerous enemy in the backline rather than dumping your abilities on Maokai, and finish enemies below the execute threshold first with R Death From Below to keep the resets going. Leave yourself an exit when you go in.
Maokai.watch: Watch out for the root from Maokai W Twisted Advance, and don’t enter range near bushes while it’s ready. Avoid bushes planted with Maokai E Sapling Toss, and if a sapling follows you, lure it toward minions or monsters instead of an ally. If Maokai R Nature’s Grasp approaches from a distance, move perpendicular to its path.

Morgana.build: Aim for a first core item with armor penetration. If you need to withstand Morgana's magic damage, build magic resistance first. If you are likely to die to attacks chained from a binding into a stun, prioritize tenacity. If a long fight makes healing from Morgana P Soul Siphon and Morgana W Tormented Shadow a problem, consider Grievous Wounds.
Morgana.combo: If Morgana E Black Shield is down and you dodge Morgana Q Dark Binding, hold Pyke Q Bone Skewer to pull a target, then immediately follow with Pyke E Phantom Undertow to stun. Follow with basic attacks to lower health, then finish with Pyke R Death From Below when health falls below its execute threshold. If you have closed in from out of vision, use Pyke W Ghostwater Dive to approach, tap Pyke Q Bone Skewer, then use Pyke E Phantom Undertow.
Morgana.escape: Go in when Morgana Q Dark Binding misses and Morgana E Black Shield is down. Morgana has no ability to create distance on her own, so close the gap with Pyke E Phantom Undertow or Pyke R Death From Below, then hit Pyke Q Bone Skewer. Before going in, decide whether to save Pyke E Phantom Undertow for an escape or rely on allied crowd control and use it to engage.
Morgana.fight: Dodge Morgana Q Dark Binding and close the distance when Morgana E Black Shield is down. At close range, tap Pyke Q Bone Skewer for a quick attack, then use Pyke E Phantom Undertow to look for a stun. If you take damage, break vision with Pyke W Ghostwater Dive or a brush, heal with Pyke P Gift of the Drowned Ones, then fight again.
Morgana.laning: Move with minions between you and Morgana, prioritizing dodging Morgana Q Dark Binding. Keep up pressure with Pyke Q Bone Skewer from brushes and vision gaps, then go in with your allied ADC after they push the wave. When the wave is pushing toward the enemy and your ADC can hold alone, use Pyke W Ghostwater Dive to gain vision or roam.
Morgana.phase: In the late game, Pyke is easy to burst down first and has trouble executing enemies whose health has increased, so avoid reckless first engages.
Morgana.teamfight: Don't use crowd control on a target with Morgana E Black Shield active. After the shield is down and your allies engage with crowd control, use Pyke W Ghostwater Dive to approach the backline from the side. Look for the most dangerous target while keeping an escape route in mind with Pyke E Phantom Undertow or Pyke R Death From Below. Execute the lowest-health enemy first with Pyke R Death From Below to chain its resets.
Morgana.watch: If Morgana Q Dark Binding hits you, Morgana W Tormented Shadow and follow-up attacks will come next, so keep minions between you and her to avoid the binding angle. When low on health, don't stay on or retreat through Morgana W Tormented Shadow. If Morgana R Soul Shackles catches you, use Pyke E Phantom Undertow or Pyke R Death From Below to get out of range before the stun triggers.

Nami.build: Consider Executioner’s Calling early to reduce the healing from Nami W Ebb and Flow. Then complete a first core item with lethality to make the most of Pyke’s power spike. If you build resistance against Nami’s damage, choose magic resistance over armor.
Nami.combo: After Nami Q Aqua Prison misses, hold Pyke Q Bone Skewer to pull a target, then immediately follow with Pyke E Phantom Undertow on hit to stun. Lower health with autos, then finish with Pyke R Death From Below once health is within execute range. If you’ve closed in with Pyke W Ghostwater Dive, tap Pyke Q Bone Skewer for a quick stab, then follow with Pyke E Phantom Undertow.
Nami.escape: Nami has no mobility, so the moment after Nami Q Aqua Prison misses is your chance to engage. Wait for Nami E Tidecaller’s Blessing to expire before fighting targets affected by it. When you go in, plan an exit with Pyke E Phantom Undertow in advance.
Nami.fight: Back off while Nami E Tidecaller’s Blessing is active and re-engage when its duration ends. If Nami Q Aqua Prison misses, engage on Nami. If you take damage and back off, break vision with Pyke W Ghostwater Dive to heal with Pyke P Gift of the Drowned Ones, then look for another angle.
Nami.laning: Move between bushes and vision blind spots to keep Nami under pressure within Pyke Q Bone Skewer’s range. Look for an angle to go in together if your allied marksman has pushed the wave. Threaten to catch Nami with Pyke W Ghostwater Dive, and roam when the wave is pushing toward the enemy and your allied marksman can hold alone.
Nami.phase: In mid game, after completing your first core item with lethality, affect other lanes with roams. In the late game, it’s hard to get enemies below the execute threshold and Pyke is easy to burst first, so avoid forcing an engage first.
Nami.teamfight: After allied crowd control lands, flank with Pyke W Ghostwater Dive and target a dangerous enemy in the backline. If Nami R Tidal Wave appears, dodge to the side and save Pyke E Phantom Undertow for the Nami Q Aqua Prison that follows. Execute the lowest-health enemy first with Pyke R Death From Below to keep the resets going.
Nami.watch: Nami Q Aqua Prison stuns but falls slowly, so dodge to the side when you see it coming. Dodge Nami R Tidal Wave to the side as well, and save Pyke E Phantom Undertow to prepare for the Nami Q Aqua Prison that follows. Avoid front-on trades with targets affected by Nami E Tidecaller’s Blessing.

Nautilus.build: Nautilus has fairly high armor, so aim for a first core item with armor penetration. If you need defense, build magic resistance first to prepare for the magic damage from Nautilus Q Dredge Line, W Titan's Wrath, and E Riptide.
Nautilus.combo: If Nautilus Q Dredge Line is down, hold Pyke Q Bone Skewer to pull a target, immediately use Pyke E Phantom Undertow, then follow with basic attacks. Finish with Pyke R Death From Below when health falls below its execute threshold. If you have closed in from out of vision with Pyke W Ghostwater Dive, you can tap Pyke Q Bone Skewer, then follow with Pyke E Phantom Undertow.
Nautilus.escape: The opening to engage is right after you bait out Nautilus Q Dredge Line. Close the gap with Pyke E Phantom Undertow and catch him with Pyke Q Bone Skewer. Before going in, decide whether to save Pyke E Phantom Undertow for an escape or rely on allied crowd control to create a way out.
Nautilus.fight: Trade right after Nautilus Q Dredge Line misses. Pull him with Pyke Q Bone Skewer, then immediately follow with Pyke E Phantom Undertow to layer the stun, and create distance before Nautilus P Staggering Blow can hit you with a basic attack. If Nautilus E Riptide is used right next to you, don't rush in before its waves end.
Nautilus.laning: Block Nautilus Q Dredge Line angles from behind minions, and keep up pressure with Pyke Q Bone Skewer by moving between brushes and vision gaps. Look for an opening to go in with your allied ADC after they push the wave. Roam only when the wave is pushing toward the enemy and your ADC can hold alone.
Nautilus.phase: In the late game, it's hard to get enemies whose health has increased below the execute threshold, so don't force an engage first.
Nautilus.teamfight: If Nautilus R Depth Charge is available, don't stand in line with your allies. After your allies land crowd control, use Pyke W Ghostwater Dive to approach from the side and target a dangerous backliner. Execute the lowest-health enemy with Pyke R Death From Below, then target the next one if you get a reset.
Nautilus.watch: Nautilus Q Dredge Line is his main engage, so dodge it by keeping minions between you and him. If Nautilus P Staggering Blow roots you with its first basic attack, his follow-up abilities are likely to hit, so stay out of his attack range. When Nautilus R Depth Charge is available, don't stand in line with your allies.

Neeko.build: Build magic resistance first to prepare for the magic damage from Neeko Q Blooming Burst, Neeko W Shapesplitter, and Neeko E Tangle-Barbs. If you are likely to die to Neeko R Pop Blossom after being rooted by Neeko E Tangle-Barbs, prioritize tenacity even more. A first core item with armor penetration creates Pyke's strong timing.
Neeko.combo: When Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is down, hold Pyke Q Bone Skewer to pull a target, then immediately follow with Pyke E Phantom Undertow on hit to stun. Follow with basic attacks to lower health, then finish with Pyke R Death From Below when health falls below its execute threshold. If you have closed in from out of vision, use Pyke W Ghostwater Dive, tap Pyke Q Bone Skewer, then use Pyke E Phantom Undertow.
Neeko.escape: When going in with Pyke E Phantom Undertow, position Neeko on the revenant's return path and plan your escape before engaging.
Neeko.fight: Close the gap with Pyke E Phantom Undertow and catch her with Pyke Q Bone Skewer. If you take damage, break vision with Pyke W Ghostwater Dive or a brush, heal with Pyke P Gift of the Drowned Ones, then go in again.
Neeko.laning: Go in with your allied ADC after they push the wave, and spread out from your allies to dodge Neeko E Tangle-Barbs. When the wave is pushing toward the enemy and your ADC can hold alone, use Pyke W Ghostwater Dive to apply pressure or roam.
Neeko.phase: In the late game, Pyke has trouble getting enemies whose health has increased below his execute threshold and is easy to burst down first, so avoid engaging first.
Neeko.teamfight: If a disguised Neeko approaches, spread out from your allies to watch for Neeko R Pop Blossom, and leave its area when you see the windup. After your allies land crowd control, use Pyke W Ghostwater Dive to approach from the side and target a dangerous backliner. Use Pyke R Death From Below on enemies whose health has decreased to chain executes and resets.
Neeko.watch: Neeko E Tangle-Barbs grows and speeds up when it hits the first target, so don't stand in line with your allies. If a disguised Neeko approaches, you may not see the windup for Neeko R Pop Blossom, so spread out in advance. Don't chase the clone from Neeko W Shapesplitter; track the real Neeko.

Rakan.build: Rakan's main threat is starting fights with Rakan W Grand Entrance and Rakan R The Quickness, so get a crowd-control cleanse first. If you build resistance against Rakan's damage, choose magic resistance. Armor won't reduce his ability damage.
Rakan.combo: After dodging or baiting out Rakan W Grand Entrance, hold Pyke Q Bone Skewer to pull him. Immediately follow a hit with Pyke E Phantom Undertow to layer the stun, then finish with Pyke R Death From Below after basic attacks bring him below its execute threshold. At close range, tap Pyke Q Bone Skewer for a quick hit, then follow with Pyke E Phantom Undertow.
Rakan.escape: The opening for Pyke to go in is right after Rakan uses Rakan W Grand Entrance but misses the knock-up. If Rakan is away from his allies, he also has no one to dash to with Rakan E Battle Dance, so close the gap with Pyke E Phantom Undertow and hit Pyke Q Bone Skewer. Before going in, decide whether to save Pyke E Phantom Undertow for an escape or rely on allied crowd control to get out.
Rakan.fight: Trade right after the shield from Rakan P Fey Feathers is removed. Sidestep the landing of Rakan W Grand Entrance, then counterattack with Pyke Q Bone Skewer and Pyke E Phantom Undertow. When using Pyke E Phantom Undertow, position Rakan on the revenant's return path and keep an escape route in mind.
Rakan.laning: Keep up pressure with Pyke Q Bone Skewer by moving between brushes and vision gaps, and look for an opening to go in with your allied ADC after they push the wave. When Rakan is away from his allies to gain vision or move around, he has no ally to dash to with Rakan E Battle Dance, creating an opportunity to catch him. Roam when the wave is pushing toward the enemy and your ADC can hold alone.
Rakan.phase: In the mid game, after completing a first core item with armor penetration, influence other lanes by roaming. In the late game, it's hard to get enemies whose health has increased below your execute threshold, and Pyke can be burst down quickly, so avoid engaging first.
Rakan.teamfight: Watch for fights started by Rakan W Grand Entrance and Rakan R The Quickness, and stand in a line with your allies so you aren't charmed together. Pyke Q Bone Skewer and Pyke E Phantom Undertow require aim, so instead of forcing them on a moving Rakan, wait for allied crowd control, then target a dangerous backliner from the side. Execute a low-health enemy first with Pyke R Death From Below to chain resets.
Rakan.watch: Rakan W Grand Entrance has a visible landing point, so sidestep when Rakan starts moving. Once Rakan R The Quickness is active, it's hard to escape on foot, so pull him with Pyke Q Bone Skewer or put terrain between you before he reaches you. If you stand in a line, he can charm several of you at once.

Rell.build: Prioritize completing a first core item with armor penetration to make the most of Pyke's strong timing. Against Rell's main damage, build magic resistance over armor, while keeping in mind that Rell P Break the Mold reduces resistances and Rell E Full Tilt deals damage based on maximum health.
Rell.combo: When Rell's mobility and crowd control are down and an opening appears, hold Pyke Q Bone Skewer to pull her, then immediately follow a hit with Pyke E Phantom Undertow to layer the stun. Follow with basic attacks to lower her health, then finish with Pyke R Death From Below when she reaches its execute threshold. If you have a close-range angle, approach with Pyke W Ghostwater Dive, tap Pyke Q Bone Skewer, then follow with Pyke E Phantom Undertow.
Rell.escape: Don't go in just because Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down is down; check Rell E Full Tilt too. In particular, before Rell E Full Tilt comes back up, use the opening when her crowd control is down to close the gap with Pyke E Phantom Undertow or Pyke R Death From Below and hit Pyke Q Bone Skewer.
Rell.fight: When Rell is mounted, apply pressure outside Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down range and don't recklessly engage first. Immediately after she dismounts with Crash Down, create distance, then plan an escape route and look for an opening to fight again with Pyke Q Bone Skewer and Pyke E Phantom Undertow. If you take damage, break vision with Pyke W Ghostwater Dive or a brush and heal with Pyke P Gift of the Drowned Ones.
Rell.laning: Keep up pressure with Pyke Q Bone Skewer from brushes and vision gaps, but don't stay in range of Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down for long. If enemies rush toward you with Rell E Full Tilt, back away, then look for an opening to go in with your allied ADC after they push the wave. Roam when the wave is pushing toward the enemy and your allied ADC can hold alone.
Rell.phase: In the late game, Pyke has trouble executing enemies whose health has increased and can be burst down quickly, so don't fight from the front for long.
Rell.teamfight: Before engaging, spread out from your allies so you aren't all pulled in by Rell R Magnet Storm. Once your allies land crowd control and keep the enemy's attention, approach from the side with Pyke W Ghostwater Dive, keeping in mind a way out with Pyke E Phantom Undertow. Finish low-health backliners first with Pyke R Death From Below to chain resets.
Rell.watch: If Rell E Full Tilt speeds up Rell and an ally, it's a signal that Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down may be used to engage, so stop trading and move out of range. Dodge Rell Q Shattering Strike in a straight line, and keep your distance from allies so several of you aren't pulled in by Rell R Magnet Storm.

Renata.build: Prioritize completing a first core item with armor penetration to bring forward Pyke's strong timing. Magic resistance is more effective than armor against Renata Glasc's damage. Renata Glasc Q Handshake and Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover are the main threats, so also get a crowd-control cleanse.
Renata.combo: At range, hold Pyke Q Bone Skewer to pull Renata Glasc, immediately follow a hit with Pyke E Phantom Undertow to stun her, then finish with basic attacks and Pyke R Death From Below. If you have closed in with Pyke W Ghostwater Dive, tap Pyke Q Bone Skewer for a quick hit, then follow with Pyke E Phantom Undertow. If Renata Glasc is still above the execute threshold, lower her health more before using Pyke R Death From Below.
Renata.escape: When Renata Glasc Q Handshake misses or is down, that's an opportunity to close the gap. Renata Glasc has no built-in mobility, so get close with Pyke E Phantom Undertow, then stop her movement with Pyke Q Bone Skewer. If Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover is available, keep your distance from allies as you go in.
Renata.fight: Deal damage briefly, back away, then break vision with Pyke W Ghostwater Dive or a brush to heal with Pyke P Gift of the Drowned Ones. When Renata Glasc Q Handshake misses or is down, close the gap with Pyke E Phantom Undertow and catch her with Pyke Q Bone Skewer. Before going in, decide whether to save Pyke E Phantom Undertow for an escape or engage in coordination with allied crowd control.
Renata.laning: Keep Renata Glasc within Pyke Q Bone Skewer range and apply pressure from brushes and vision gaps. If your allied ADC pushes the wave, go after Renata Glasc together. Use Pyke W Ghostwater Dive to make her back off and gain vision, or roam when the wave is pushing toward the enemy and your allied ADC can hold alone.
Renata.phase: In the late game, it's hard to get enemies below the execute threshold, and Pyke can be burst down quickly, so don't fight at the front.
Renata.teamfight: While Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover is available, keep your distance from allies. After your allies land crowd control, approach from the side with Pyke W Ghostwater Dive. Target a dangerous backliner, but leave yourself an escape route when you go in. Use Pyke R Death From Below on the lowest-health enemy first to chain resets, and right after killing an enemy affected by Renata Glasc W Bailout, protect your allies while keeping your distance.
Renata.watch: If Renata Glasc Q Handshake hits you, it roots and can stun your allies after she throws you, so dodge its angle from behind minions. When Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover is available, keep your distance from allies as you engage. An enemy affected by Renata Glasc W Bailout can keep fighting right after being killed, so back away to avoid an ally dying nearby.

Senna.build: Build armor first since Senna's main damage is physical. Senna P Absolution adds current-health damage to her basic attacks, so build armor along with health instead of stacking health alone. Pyke's bonus maximum health converts into attack damage, and his power spikes sharply after completing his first core item with armor penetration.
Senna.combo: If you have an angle to pull Senna, hold Pyke Q Bone Skewer and immediately follow a hit with Pyke E Phantom Undertow to layer the stun. Follow with basic attacks to lower her health, then finish with Pyke R Death From Below when she is below its execute threshold. If you have closed in from out of vision, use Pyke W Ghostwater Dive → tap Pyke Q Bone Skewer → Pyke E Phantom Undertow.
Senna.escape: When Senna W Last Embrace is down, you have an opening to go in without worrying about its root. Senna E Curse of the Black Mist increases movement speed but isn't a mobility ability that creates distance, so close the gap with Pyke E Phantom Undertow and catch her with Pyke Q Bone Skewer. Before going in, plan an escape route using Pyke E Phantom Undertow or allied crowd control.
Senna.fight: Close in to fight when Senna W Last Embrace is down. At close range, tap Pyke Q Bone Skewer for a quick hit, then use Pyke E Phantom Undertow to look for a stun. If you take damage in the trade, break vision with Pyke W Ghostwater Dive or a brush and heal with Pyke P Gift of the Drowned Ones.
Senna.laning: Watch where Senna's souls drop and pressure her when she comes out to collect them. Go in with your allied ADC after they push the wave, and roam only when your ADC can hold alone.
Senna.phase: In the late game, Senna's range and attack damage scale up while Pyke can be burst down quickly, so avoid recklessly engaging first.
Senna.teamfight: When you see Senna E Curse of the Black Mist, enemies inside can approach camouflaged, so retreat to an area with vision. After your allies land crowd control, approach Senna from the side with Pyke W Ghostwater Dive, leaving yourself a way out. When Senna falls below the execute threshold, use Pyke R Death From Below, and if the execute gives you a reset, target another low-health enemy.
Senna.watch: Senna Q Piercing Darkness passes through minions and champions to slow enemies and heal allies, so avoid standing in a line with Senna and her target. Senna W Last Embrace roots after a delay, so block it from behind minions, and move away from allies if you are marked. If Senna hits you once, back off to avoid a second attack and deny her Mist collection.

Seraphine.build: Prioritize completing your first core item with lethality to reach Pyke’s power spike sooner. Build magic resistance rather than armor to withstand Seraphine’s damage. Bonus maximum health converts into attack damage for Pyke, but magic resistance itself does not convert into damage.
Seraphine.combo: When Seraphine E Beat Drop is down and you have an angle to hook, hold Pyke Q Bone Skewer and immediately follow the pull with Pyke E Phantom Undertow to chain the stun. Then use basic attacks to lower her health, and finish with Pyke R Death From Below once she is below its execute threshold. If you’re already close, tap Pyke Q Bone Skewer for a quick stab, then follow with Pyke E Phantom Undertow.
Seraphine.escape: The moment after Seraphine E Beat Drop misses is your chance to engage. Seraphine has no mobility spell, so use Pyke E Phantom Undertow to close in and land Pyke Q Bone Skewer. Before going in, decide how you’ll get out instead of relying on Pyke E Phantom Undertow.
Seraphine.fight: Right after dodging Seraphine E Beat Drop, close the gap with Pyke E Phantom Undertow. Look to trade when Seraphine is alone and separated from her ADC. If you take damage, break vision with Pyke W Ghostwater Dive or a brush to heal with Pyke P Gift of the Drowned Ones.
Seraphine.laning: Keep Seraphine within Pyke Q Bone Skewer range, but don’t engage first if it means taking heavy damage. Look for an opening after Seraphine E Beat Drop is down when your ADC has pushed the wave and can follow up. Use Pyke W Ghostwater Dive to pressure and establish vision, or roam when the wave is pushing toward the enemy and your ADC can hold alone.
Seraphine.phase: In the late game, it’s difficult for Pyke to get enemies with increased health below his execute threshold, and he can be burst down first, so engage carefully.
Seraphine.teamfight: Spread out to the sides so Seraphine R Encore doesn’t hit multiple allies. Once your team’s crowd control lands and the enemy’s attention is occupied, flank with Pyke W Ghostwater Dive and target a dangerous backliner. Execute low-health targets first with Pyke R Death From Below to chain its resets, and leave yourself an escape route when you go in.
Seraphine.watch: Seraphine E Beat Drop roots Pyke if he is already slowed, so move out of the straight line in front of Seraphine when you get hit by a slow. When low on health, watch out for Seraphine Q High Note, which deals damage based on missing health. In teamfights, Seraphine R Encore reaches farther each time it passes through an allied champion, so don’t line up.

Sona.build: Build magic resistance first against Sona’s main damage. For offense, aim for a first core item with lethality. If Sona’s healing is a problem, have your team’s physical damage dealer build Executioner’s Calling.
Sona.combo: When Sona steps forward, hold Pyke Q Bone Skewer and follow the pull immediately with Pyke E Phantom Undertow to chain the stun. Then use basic attacks to lower health and use Pyke R Death From Below once the execute threshold is met. If you’re already close, approach with Pyke W Ghostwater Dive, tap Pyke Q Bone Skewer, then follow with Pyke E Phantom Undertow.
Sona.escape: The window after Sona R Crescendo is down is a good time to engage with Pyke E Phantom Undertow. Sona has no spell to create distance on her own, but she can speed herself up with Sona E Song of Celerity, so once you’re close, lock her down with the pull from Pyke Q Bone Skewer and the stun from Pyke E Phantom Undertow.
Sona.fight: When Sona steps forward to share her aura, pull her in with Pyke Q Bone Skewer and trade. Pressure her to keep using Sona W Aria of Perseverance to heal, but if Pyke takes heavy damage, break vision with Pyke W Ghostwater Dive or a brush to heal through his passive. Before going in, decide how you’ll get out with Pyke E Phantom Undertow.
Sona.laning: Pressure Sona when she steps forward by moving between brushes and vision gaps, then go in with your ADC after they push the wave. Roam when the wave is pushing toward the enemy and your ADC can hold alone.
Sona.phase: In the late game, Sona’s healing and scaling become strong, and Pyke can be burst down first, so avoid extended fights.
Sona.teamfight: Pull Sona out of position with Pyke Q Bone Skewer to stop her from sharing her aura with allies. After your team’s crowd control lands, approach from the side with Pyke W Ghostwater Dive and spread out to the left and right from your allies to avoid getting hit together by Sona R Crescendo. When the lowest-health enemy is within your execute threshold, finish them with Pyke R Death From Below to chain its resets.
Sona.watch: Sona R Crescendo stuns multiple enemies in a line, so don’t line up with your allies when Sona steps forward. If Sona moves into attack range as though Sona P Power Chord is ready, expect a slow or bonus damage and create distance. Enemies sped up by Sona E Song of Celerity are hard to catch with a slow alone, so look to stun them with Pyke E Phantom Undertow.

Soraka.build: Soraka Q Starcall and Soraka E Equinox deal magic damage, so build magic resistance first. If Soraka’s healing becomes a problem in extended fights, consider Grievous Wounds next. Pyke becomes strong after completing his first core item with lethality.
Soraka.combo: At range, hold Pyke Q Bone Skewer and follow the pull immediately with Pyke E Phantom Undertow. After a basic attack, use Pyke R Death From Below when you can execute. If you’re already close, approach with Pyke W Ghostwater Dive, tap Pyke Q Bone Skewer, then follow with Pyke E Phantom Undertow. Keep Soraka between the start and end points of Pyke E Phantom Undertow so its stun connects.
Soraka.escape: The moment after Soraka E Equinox is used for poke or waveclear is your chance to engage. Soraka has no mobility spell, so close in with Pyke E Phantom Undertow and catch her with Pyke Q Bone Skewer. Before going in, decide whether to save Pyke E Phantom Undertow for your escape or rely on your team’s crowd control to create time to get out.
Soraka.fight: Once you see Soraka E Equinox is down, approach with Pyke W Ghostwater Dive or close the gap with Pyke E Phantom Undertow. Avoid Soraka Q Starcall to stop her from healing, and burst her quickly to leave less time for her to survive with Soraka R Wish. If you take heavy damage, break vision and heal with Pyke P Gift of the Drowned Ones before going back in.
Soraka.laning: Move between brush and vision gaps and apply pressure with Pyke Q Bone Skewer’s range. Pressure the enemy ADC alongside your own ADC to make Soraka use Soraka W Astral Infusion, which costs Soraka health. You must dodge Soraka Q Starcall to keep up the pressure.
Soraka.phase: After completing your first core item with lethality, extend your lead through roams. In the late game, it becomes harder to get enemies below your execute threshold, and Pyke can be burst down first, so avoid recklessly engaging first.
Soraka.teamfight: After your team’s crowd control lands, approach Soraka from the side with Pyke W Ghostwater Dive. Use Pyke R Death From Below on the lowest-health enemy you can execute to chain its resets.
Soraka.watch: If Soraka hits you with Soraka Q Starcall, she heals and gains movement speed, so dodge it. You are silenced inside Soraka E Equinox and may be rooted, so use your engage spell before stepping into its zone. Soraka R Wish heals allies regardless of distance, so keep it in mind even just before an execute.

Swain.build: Aim for a first core item with lethality. Build magic resistance to withstand Swain’s damage. If the matchup is likely to involve extended fights, consider Grievous Wounds after magic resistance.
Swain.combo: When Swain E Nevermove is down, hold Pyke Q Bone Skewer to pull him in, then immediately follow with Pyke E Phantom Undertow to chain the stun. Use basic attacks to lower his health, then finish with Pyke R Death From Below once he is below its execute threshold. If you engage at close range with Pyke W Ghostwater Dive, tap Pyke Q Bone Skewer and follow with Pyke E Phantom Undertow.
Swain.escape: Swain has no mobility or escape spell, so go in just after Swain E Nevermove is down and its returning wave has disappeared. Close in with Pyke E Phantom Undertow and land Pyke Q Bone Skewer. Before engaging, decide whether you’ll make an escape route with Pyke E Phantom Undertow or use your team’s crowd control.
Swain.fight: The moment after you dodge the returning wave of Swain E Nevermove is your chance to engage. Close the gap with Pyke E Phantom Undertow, positioning Swain on the line of the returning phantom to stun him. If you take damage, break vision with Pyke W Ghostwater Dive or a brush to heal with Pyke P Gift of the Drowned Ones, then fight again.
Swain.laning: Early on, keep up the pressure with Pyke Q Bone Skewer by moving between brushes and vision gaps, but don’t force an engage while Swain E Nevermove is still available. Look for an angle to go in with your ADC after they push the wave. When the wave is pushing toward the enemy and your ADC can hold alone, use Pyke W Ghostwater Dive to pressure, then establish river vision or roam.
Swain.phase: As the game goes on, Swain gains health and sustain, making him harder to kill with the same openings. In the late game, Pyke also struggles to lower enemies’ health to his execute threshold.
Swain.teamfight: If Swain R Demonic Ascension is active, get out of range and re-engage once it ends. After your team’s crowd control lands and the enemy’s attention is occupied, approach from the side with Pyke W Ghostwater Dive and target a dangerous backliner. Execute the lowest-health enemy with Pyke R Death From Below to chain its resets, and leave yourself an escape route when you go in.
Swain.watch: Swain E Nevermove roots and pulls you if you’re hit by either the outgoing or returning wave, so stay out of its path until it disappears completely. Swain Q Death’s Hand is more painful at close range because multiple bolts can overlap, so keep your distance. When Swain R Demonic Ascension is active, don’t fight near him; get out of range and wait for it to end.

Taric.build: Aim to complete your first core item with lethality. Build magic resistance to withstand the damage from Taric P Bravado and Taric E Dazzle. Bonus health converts into attack damage for Pyke.
Taric.combo: After dodging Taric E Dazzle, hold Pyke Q Bone Skewer to pull him in, then immediately follow with Pyke E Phantom Undertow as he is pulled toward you to chain the stun. Then use basic attacks to lower his health and use Pyke R Death From Below when you can execute. If you’re already close, tap Pyke Q Bone Skewer for a quick stab, then follow with Pyke E Phantom Undertow.
Taric.escape: When Taric E Dazzle is down, it’s Pyke’s chance to engage. Taric has no spell to create distance on his own, so catch him with Pyke Q Bone Skewer and close the gap with Pyke E Phantom Undertow. Before going in, decide whether to save Pyke E Phantom Undertow for your escape or rely on your team’s crowd control to get out.
Taric.fight: Dodge Taric E Dazzle to the side, then engage. Don’t take repeated empowered attacks from Taric P Bravado in a close trade; use Pyke Q Bone Skewer to pull or push Taric and reduce his chances to attack. When Taric R Cosmic Radiance is being cast, decide whether to finish your attack before its damage immunity activates or back off.
Taric.laning: Keep up pressure with Pyke Q Bone Skewer by moving between brushes and vision gaps, but don’t accept Taric’s strong early close-range trades. When your ADC has pushed the wave and can go in with you, bait out Taric E Dazzle before fighting. Use Pyke W Ghostwater Dive to pressure and establish vision or roam only when the wave is pushing toward the enemy and your ADC can hold alone.
Taric.phase: In the late game, it’s difficult for Pyke to get enemies with increased health below his execute threshold, and he can be burst down first, so avoid engaging first.
Taric.teamfight: After your team’s crowd control lands, approach from the side with Pyke W Ghostwater Dive and target a dangerous backliner. While Taric R Cosmic Radiance’s damage immunity is active, lock down enemies with Pyke Q Bone Skewer and Pyke E Phantom Undertow, then deal damage after the immunity ends. Finish off targets you can execute first with Pyke R Death From Below to chain its resets.
Taric.watch: When you see the tell for Taric E Dazzle, move sideways to dodge it. When the damage immunity from Taric R Cosmic Radiance activates, stop attacking and use Pyke Q Bone Skewer or Pyke E Phantom Undertow to lock down their position until it ends.

Thresh.build: Prioritize completing your first core item with lethality to reach Pyke’s power spike sooner. If you build resistance against Thresh’s ability damage, choose magic resistance over armor. Bonus health converts into attack damage independently of Pyke P Gift of the Drowned Ones, so items with health help with both defense and damage.
Thresh.combo: After dodging Thresh Q Death Sentence, if Thresh W Dark Passage is not yet back, hold Pyke Q Bone Skewer to pull him in and immediately follow with Pyke E Phantom Undertow as he is pulled toward you to chain the stun. Then use basic attacks and finish with Pyke R Death From Below once he is within execute range. If you’re already close, approach with Pyke W Ghostwater Dive, tap Pyke Q Bone Skewer, then follow with Pyke E Phantom Undertow.
Thresh.escape: The moment after Thresh Q Death Sentence is down is your chance to close the gap. Thresh can also use Thresh W Dark Passage to escape, so look especially for an opening before that spell is back. Use Pyke E Phantom Undertow or Pyke R Death From Below to close in and land Pyke Q Bone Skewer during that window.
Thresh.fight: Dodge Thresh Q Death Sentence to the side, then close the gap. Trade when Thresh steps forward to collect souls, and if you take damage, break vision with Pyke W Ghostwater Dive or a brush to heal with Pyke P Gift of the Drowned Ones. When engaging with Pyke E Phantom Undertow, position Thresh on the returning phantom’s line and plan your escape route.
Thresh.laning: Pressure from brush and vision gaps with Pyke Q Bone Skewer’s range. Look for an angle to go in with your ADC after they push the wave, and don’t force the first attack before dodging Thresh Q Death Sentence. If you’ve forced the enemy back with pressure from Pyke W Ghostwater Dive, establish river vision or roam mid when the wave is pushing toward the enemy and your allies can hold alone.
Thresh.phase: In mid game, after completing your first core item with lethality, influence other lanes through roams. In the late game, enemies with increased health are harder to execute, Pyke can be taken down first, and Thresh gets tankier as he collects souls.
Thresh.teamfight: After your team’s crowd control lands, approach the backline from the side with Pyke W Ghostwater Dive and target a dangerous enemy. Use Pyke R Death From Below on enemies within execute range to chain its resets. If you’re caught in Thresh R The Box, immediately decide with your allies which direction to break through. If Thresh W Dark Passage is thrown toward a target, finish that target off right away or stop the chase.
Thresh.watch: When you see Thresh lift his hook for Thresh Q Death Sentence, move sideways to dodge it. Avoid the line between Thresh and his allies so Thresh E Flay doesn’t pull you toward them. When Thresh W Dark Passage is thrown, finish off its target before they escape or back off.

Velkoz.build: Prioritize completing your first core item with lethality to exploit Vel’Koz’s low armor.
