Build magic resistance against Vel’Koz Q Plasma Fission, W Void Rift, and E Tectonic Disruption, but resistance can’t block the true damage from Vel’Koz P Organic Deconstruction or R Life Form Disintegration Ray. Bonus health converts into attack damage for Pyke and also increases your total health for surviving true damage.
Velkoz.combo: From out of vision, approach with Pyke W Ghostwater Dive, tap Pyke Q Bone Skewer at close range, then follow with Pyke E Phantom Undertow. If you have an angle to hook, hold Pyke Q Bone Skewer and immediately use Pyke E Phantom Undertow after it hits to chain the stun. After a basic attack, use Pyke R Death From Below on Vel’Koz once he is within execute range.
Velkoz.escape: Vel’Koz has no mobility spell, so the moment after you dodge Vel’Koz E Tectonic Disruption is your chance to engage. Close the gap with Pyke E Phantom Undertow or Pyke R Death From Below, then catch him with Pyke Q Bone Skewer. Before going in, decide whether you’ll make an escape route with Pyke E Phantom Undertow or your team’s crowd control.
Velkoz.fight: After dodging Vel’Koz E Tectonic Disruption, close the gap with Pyke E Phantom Undertow, positioning Vel’Koz on the returning phantom’s line. Vel’Koz E Tectonic Disruption can knock you back at close range, so decide how you’ll finish the fight and escape before going in. If you take poke, break vision with Pyke W Ghostwater Dive or a brush to heal with Pyke P Gift of the Drowned Ones, then look for another opening.
Velkoz.laning: Pressure with Pyke Q Bone Skewer range from brush and vision gaps, but avoid engaging first if it means taking a chain of Vel’Koz spells. When your ADC has pushed the wave and Vel’Koz E Tectonic Disruption is down, go in together. Clear vision in the river and tri-brush to create a flank route. Roam when the wave is pushing toward the enemy and your ADC can hold alone.
Velkoz.phase: After completing your first core item with lethality, exploit Vel’Koz’s low armor and pressure other lanes through roams. In the late game, it’s difficult for Pyke to lower enemies’ health to his execute threshold, and he can be burst down first, so avoid forcing an engage before your allies go in.
Velkoz.teamfight: After your team’s crowd control lands, approach from the side with Pyke W Ghostwater Dive and target dangerous backliners, including Vel’Koz. When Vel’Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray starts, interrupt the channel with Pyke E Phantom Undertow’s stun or another tool. Finish off the lowest-health enemy first with Pyke R Death From Below to chain its resets.
Velkoz.watch: For Vel’Koz Q Plasma Fission, dodge the split beam too; don’t just move sideways—move toward Vel’Koz or behind where the beam passed. If Vel’Koz W Void Rift and E Tectonic Disruption both hit in succession, Vel’Koz P Organic Deconstruction triggers true damage, so back off and let it pass when you have stacks on you. When Vel’Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray starts, first look for an angle to interrupt it with the stun from Pyke E Phantom Undertow.

Xerath.build: Aim for a first core item with lethality. Xerath has relatively low armor, so Pyke’s physical damage is effective. Build magic resistance rather than armor against Xerath’s damage, but prioritize a way to block or remove the stun from Xerath E Shocking Orb.
Xerath.combo: Once Xerath E Shocking Orb is down, hold Pyke Q Bone Skewer to pull him in. Immediately follow with Pyke E Phantom Undertow after Q hits to chain the stun, then use basic attacks and finish with Pyke R Death From Below once he is within its execute threshold. If you’re already close, approach with Pyke W Ghostwater Dive, tap Pyke Q Bone Skewer, then follow with Pyke E Phantom Undertow.
Xerath.escape: Xerath has no mobility spell, so the moment after Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down is your chance to engage. Close the gap with Pyke E Phantom Undertow or Pyke R Death From Below, then catch him with Pyke Q Bone Skewer. Before going in, decide whether to make an escape route with Pyke E Phantom Undertow or time your engage with your team’s crowd control.
Xerath.fight: While Xerath charges Xerath Q Arcanopulse, he slows down, giving you a window to dodge sideways and close the gap. Once Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down, approach with Pyke W Ghostwater Dive and chain Pyke Q Bone Skewer into Pyke E Phantom Undertow. If you take damage, break vision to heal with Pyke P Gift of the Drowned Ones, then look for another opening.
Xerath.laning: Keep up Pyke Q Bone Skewer pressure by moving between brushes and vision gaps, dodge heavy poke, and wait for Xerath to run low on mana. Go in with your ADC after they push the wave. If your pressure with Pyke W Ghostwater Dive forces Xerath back, establish river vision, and roam when the wave is pushing toward the enemy and your ADC can hold alone.
Xerath.phase: In the late game, it’s difficult to get enemies below your execute threshold, and Pyke can be burst down first, so avoid forcing an engage before your allies go in.
Xerath.teamfight: After your team’s crowd control lands, approach from the side with Pyke W Ghostwater Dive and target dangerous backliners, including Xerath. When you see the cast animation for Xerath R Rite of the Arcane, dodge it or look for a chance to engage on Xerath while he can’t move. Finish off low-health enemies first with Pyke R Death From Below to chain its resets, and leave yourself an escape route when you go in.
Xerath.watch: Xerath Q Arcanopulse pierces minions, so when you see him charging, change direction and dodge to the side. Watch especially for the stun from Xerath E Shocking Orb, more than the slow from Xerath W Eye of Destruction. If you’re stunned, you can take the full follow-up magic damage.

Zilean.build: Pyke should prioritize completing his first core item with lethality to create more execute opportunities. Being caught by the slow from Zilean E Time Warp and the stun from Zilean Q Time Bomb is dangerous, so get tenacity first. If you need to withstand Zilean’s magic damage, build magic resistance.
Zilean.combo: If you can pull Zilean, hold Pyke Q Bone Skewer and follow a hit immediately with Pyke E Phantom Undertow to layer the stuns. After an auto attack, use Pyke R Death From Below when he is below the execute threshold. If you’re already close, approach with Pyke W Ghostwater Dive, tap Pyke Q Bone Skewer, then follow with Pyke E Phantom Undertow. Don’t rush an execute on a target affected by Zilean R Chronoshift.
Zilean.escape: Your chance to engage comes after Zilean E Time Warp has been used and the stun combo from Zilean Q Time Bomb has passed. Zilean has no mobility ability, so close the distance then with Pyke E Phantom Undertow or Pyke R Death From Below and hit Pyke Q Bone Skewer.
Zilean.fight: Engage from a different direction than your allies so you aren’t caught alone by Zilean E Time Warp and hit by the bomb combo.
Zilean.laning: Roam when the wave is pushing toward the enemy and your allied marksman can hold alone.
Zilean.phase: In late game, it’s hard to bring enemies whose health has increased below the execute threshold, and Pyke can easily be burst down first, so don’t start fights from the front.
Zilean.teamfight: After your allies apply crowd control, approach from the flank with Pyke W Ghostwater Dive, and plan an escape route with Pyke E Phantom Undertow. If Zilean R Chronoshift is on an enemy damage dealer, switch targets to the squishy Zilean himself. Finish enemies you can execute first with Pyke R Death From Below to keep the resets going.
Zilean.watch: If Zilean Q Time Bomb attaches to you, move away from your allies and get outside the blast radius. A target affected by Zilean R Chronoshift will revive even if killed, so wait for its duration to end or be ready to engage again right after the revive.
